name: jobscan
description: Weekly job scanner + tailored application drafter. Two cooperating skills (find/rank, then map/draft), a guided onboarding skill that builds your candidate profile, a setup check that names every silent failure, and small skills for changing settings, employers and file locations afterwards — or starting the whole setup over. Field-agnostic; works for any research-to-industry transition. Prepares packets; never submits.
